column1: # EU Building Stock Observatory (BSO) -- Portugal residential indicators
# Used by 03_heat_intensity.py for (1) the unknown-cohort stock-weighted
# fallback intensity and (2) the BSO reconciliation row.
# stock_pct_pt: share of the Portuguese residential stock by construction
#   cohort. Censos 2021 reports 53.5% of buildings built before 1980;
#   heat intensity (delivered). DERIVED from the Spanish-proxy TABULA per-cohort
#   class-average space-heating need x climate multiplier (0.6000) x retrofit
#   blend (0.935) + DHW. Portugal's mild climate produces low intensities.
# Source: INE Portugal Censos 2021; Spanish-proxy TABULA (es_intensities.csv).
